outcome.technical:
Applied /p168-18.patch (git apply --check exit 0, git apply exit 0, plain form, index untouched) and reviewed every hunk against the acceptance; nothing needed changing. (1) tools/affected.py: cases a21f (a percent operand that is os.path.realpath wrapping _loader.script_path is still a run) and a21g (a `+` join is still a run), with the comment above TEXT_RESOLVERS naming a21e/a21f/a21g as the two sides of the edge. Only comment and _cases lines changed, so no listing or --json code path changed. (2) tools/measure-affected-miss.py: m23b (a full default with a narrower comparison is still swept: the default misses nothing, the comparison misses test_b). (3) The window line counts the full-set commits per selection when a comparison is given (m23c); without one it keeps its single count. (4) An unreadable comparison selector no longer turns the commit into could-not-measure: measure_in_tree keeps the default's reading and records compare_why; render prints `NOT MEASURED (compare) `, the compare headline counts only commits it was read on and adds `, N not measured for it`, and _compare_part says nothing for that commit (m23d). The docstring's WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY says this, and the full-set bullet now says the selection can't miss only for itself. (5) CONTRIBUTING.md:593-594 now says the command and date are in the comment above TEXT_RESOLVERS (tools/affected.py:318-324) and that the docstring (tools/affected.py:68-69) only points there. (6) Both listings are byte-identical between a pure HEAD export and the same export with the three files laid over it: `--list-all` cmp exit 0 (196 lines); `--list-related

` for 157 paths (every tracked .py under plugins/audit/scripts and plugins/audit/hooks, the three declared files and Makefile), differ 0, every exit 0, no listing empty, 18832 lines in total (script /p168-19-listings.py, exit 0).
